title: Eastern Strand
wikitext:
[[File:Eastern Strand.jpg|thumb|300px|Eastern Strand.]]

The '''Eastern Strand''' is a stretch of coastline in the southeast of [[Hillsbrad Foothills]], complementary to the [[Western Strand]] further to the west. The Eastern Strand is home to the [[Daggerspine]] [[naga]] who are found on the beaches and in the water.
